title: Streaming controlplane bootstrap event architecture
observed_behavior_before: bootstrapControlplane() called nostr.queryUntilEose(readModelFilters()) and applied read-model events only after the EOSE query resolved.
Connection status moved directly from bootstrapping to live after the blocking query completed.
intended_behavior: bootstrapControlplane() starts one streaming Nostr subscription over scoped read-model filters after relay connection.
EVENT callbacks apply controlplane projections immediately while status is syncing.
EOSE marks historical catch-up complete only after every connected bootstrap relay reports EOSE for the current subscription generation.
Stale EOSE callbacks from pre-reconnect subscriptions do not mark the current stream live.

excluded: web/src/routes/+layout.svelte and system eager connect owned by bahia-97jk
